title: Slate Turkish Borek
description: A Chinese-inspired twist on the Turkish borek pastry, served as a savory snack or light meal. Flaky crust gives way to tender beef and spices.
instructions: Roll out pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a pan over medium-high heat, cook beef until browned, breaking into small pieces.
Add soy sauce, scallions, and ginger to the pan and stir to combine.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture onto one half of the pastry rectangle.
Fold the other half of the pastry over to form a triangle or square shape.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until pastry is golden brown.
